text.description_html:
Acorn AIFBP, 24" Smooth Iron Dummy Spear Strap Hinges for Interior And Exterior Doors

The 24" Spear Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge is sure to give an old world charm to any home door, gate, shutter, or garage door without the need of installing working hinges or replacing existing hardware. This dummy hinge strap comes with a smooth iron finish that is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Also Available Matching:
14" Spear Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
18-3/4" Spear Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
31" Spear Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the Spear Tip Dummy Strap Hinges:

  • Made from heavy sand-cast aluminum.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Spear Tip Dummy Strap Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 24"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold Individually
